title: Preserve empty quoted tokens while splitting whitespace
goal: Repair tokenize_quoted(text), where text is a string. Split tokens at characters satisfying str.isspace() only while outside double quotes. A double quote toggles quoted state and is removed from output. Quoted and unquoted fragments with no separating outside whitespace concatenate into one token. Preserve an explicitly quoted empty token: two consecutive double quotes yield one empty string; adjacent empty quoted fragments without separating whitespace form one token. Preserve all characters inside quotes other than the quote delimiters, including whitespace. There is no escape syntax: backslash is always literal and does not change quote interpretation. Single quotes are ordinary characters. Raise ValueError for an unmatched double quote. Empty or all-unquoted-whitespace input returns []. Return a list of strings and preserve the signature.
constraints: Do not add files, dependencies, or modify tests.
Keep tokenize_quoted and its signature unchanged.

provenance.hidden_tests: Distinct inputs exercising the same stated specification
